newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico peso ends softer on year-end dollar cover.
newsitem.headline: Mexico peso ends softer on year-end dollar cover.

text.p: The Mexican peso extended early softness by the close of trade on Thursday due to lingering demand for dollars to cover positions, traders said.
"It was a quiet session with some dollars bought, but just to square year-end positions, they don't want to go short," a dealer said.
The benchmark 48-hour peso and its 24-hour stablemate closed 1.6 and 0.8 of a centavo weaker, respectively, at 7.8490/7.8540 per dollar.
The same-day peso earlier closed 0.60 of a centavo weaker at 7.8200/7.8275 per dollar.
Traders stressed that volume was thin and dealing light throughout the session, which they put down to the holiday season.
Dealers forecast the peso continuing its slide on Friday to a trading range of 7.84/7.86 per dollar for 48-hour contracts.
